Global summary

Of 50 dashboard panels scanned for 26–28 Jun 2026, 17 were relevant. Findings:
  • Two platform live migrations (Infrastructure-initiated, TriggerType Defrag), both Completed / Succeeded with sub-second VM blackout (~0.80 s on 06-26 07:48 and ~0.95 s on 06-27 13:23). Each moved the VM to a new physical node and rack (6d389155 → 026a845f → 72a7cab6, cluster IAD01PrdApp45).
  • Host maintenance on both nodes (HostGateway, MetadataServer, HostGAPlugin agent upgrades and BscCertifier firmware), plus a backup RestorePoint operation on 06-28 — consistent with the defrag/maintenance driving the migrations.
  • Regional context: an East US VM/VMSS management-operation PIR (IcM 824520159) overlapped 06-26 evening; it affected control-plane operations, not this VM's uptime.
  • Resource behaviour: CPU MAX bursts to ~100%, memory pressure sustained at 119–121%, brief disk-latency spikes (~64 ms), large network spikes on 06-27, and a throughput drop on 06-28 ~08:00–10:00.
No reboots, no confirmed storage/disk errors (the Storage Errors panel lists disks but no timestamped fault), no disk-detach, and no ICM/SR records for this VM.
